title: Listening Drill — Charity run reroute
description: Public announcement. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Charity run reroute
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: A quick update about the charity run. Some of you have printed the original programme, so please take a moment to change your notes. The most important change concerns the route.

ORGANISER: For now, go to the park arch. If that route is closed when you arrive, use the railway bridge instead. It takes a few minutes longer, so allow enough time.

ORGANISER: Questions should go to Bea rather than the general enquiries desk. Before you leave, attach your race number where it can be seen. We will post a further update only if another part of the plan changes.
